scope.summary: Prove the whiteboard surface (board mode, every board object type, templates, widgets, facilitation, diagram generation, board import/export) is operable from BOTH the native operator UI and the typed model command surface, honors the headless/quiet law for background board operations + model-driven generation, exposes stable AccessKit/author_id targets + structured state to Argus so a no-context model can place/connect/re-observe board objects, and is documented in the dual-audience UserManual with operator facilitation/board workflows + the model command reference for board objects and diagram generation.
acceptance_criteria: whiteboard surface dual-operable, quiet-law-honoring, Argus-visible, manual-covered
proof_targets: whiteboard Argus coverage + dual-operability + manual self-consistency
expected_tests: argus: every board object type placeable + re-observable by author_id
test: dual-operability (UI + model surface) for the whiteboard surface
HBR-MAN-003: every board command_id has a manual entry

risk_if_missed: Whiteboard surfaces not model-drivable/steerable or undocumented.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
